impact: Words separated by a tab or a newline count as one: wordCount('one\ttwo') returns 1, not 2, though the plan splits on whitespace. The tests use spaces only, so they pass.
correction: Split on runs of any whitespace (/\s+/) and test a tab- and a newline-separated text.

impact: wordCount(null) and wordCount(undefined) throw a TypeError instead of returning 0.
correction: Return 0 when text is not a string, and test it.
